findings.current: Right after parting ways with Jin-ho, I had shut myself in the Training Room
findings.defect: Drops “hyung,” the source’s familiar address for an older male friend, losing a relationship and intimacy cue preserved in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly uses 진호 형, and the glossary identifies Jin-ho as an older male friend addressed as Jin-ho hyung.
findings.replacement: Right after parting ways with Jin-ho hyung, I had shut myself in the Training Room

findings.current: Magical power levels had risen abnormally. Monsters had grown stronger, and human casualties—which had fallen dramatically after the Great Cataclysm—were once again mounting everywhere.
findings.defect: The source explicitly links the monsters’ increased strength to the abnormal rise in magical power; the English leaves that causal connection unstated.
findings.rationale: 그에 따라 means that the monsters grew stronger accordingly, establishing a causal link to the preceding rise in magical power.
findings.replacement: Magical power levels had risen abnormally. As a result, monsters had grown stronger, and human casualties—which had fallen dramatically after the Great Cataclysm—were once again mounting everywhere.

findings.current: Choi Minwoo stared at the old butler, laid to rest on this warm hill instead of a cold, snow-covered mountain.
findings.defect: Omits that Minwoo gazed blankly at the old butler, a specific physical and emotional detail present in the source and accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: 멍하니 바라보던 specifies a blank, dazed stare; “stared” alone does not carry that detail.
findings.replacement: Choi Minwoo stared blankly at the old butler, laid to rest on this warm hill instead of a cold, snow-covered mountain.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with a few minor losses of source-specific relationship, causality, and physical detail.
